integrity: The standalone exact verifier independently enumerates all filling forms and proves geometric smoothness by Jacobian-ideal Groebner bases; factorization and deck-group checks are in the same reproducible program.
scientific_limitations: This classifies the first-ruling trigonal maps of all smooth binary minimal split-quadric filling curves, not all trigonal maps or all genus-six curves; historical priority may require further specialist review.
title: Tame cyclic and wild symmetric trigonal branch profiles of all minimal binary quadric-filling curves
